entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Well, we didn't experience any of the[n]wonders of space, but at least the taste[n]was passable.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: You seemed much more excited by[n]the toy than the taste, anyway.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Sh-Shut up!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: I saw you eating around those "pickle"[n]things or whatever they are, Justine!

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Th-That wasn't food from this earth.[n]It was clearly, ah... alien spawn of[n]some sort.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: WHAT!? Is this true!?
Not at all.
They're a delicacy.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: H-Hey, is it true or not? I ate all of mine,[n]you know!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: ...They actually tasted rather good.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: I see. Well, they didn't taste bad...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: But seriously, what are they!? I ate all of[n]mine, you know!

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Calm down, Caroline. We're getting[n]off track.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Grrr... Well, at any rate, we've determined[n]that hamburgers are incapable of[n]conveying the majesty of space.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: While the toy spaceship helped to soften[n]the blow, there's no denying the truth.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Now we will formally acknowledge[n]the completion of your task.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Here is your reward.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: You better work just as hard next time![n]We know about all sorts of locations[n]that would aid your rehabilitation!

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: I'm still taken aback by the truth...[n]Your world is absolutely full of these[n]"shop" places...

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: For a reasonable fee, nearly every desire[n]can be fulfilled, all as if it were nothing.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: That does sound interesting. I believe it[n]may merit further research.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Anyways, good work, Inmate. Your final[n]task for the day is to escort us back to[n]the Velvet Room. Let's move!
I escorted the twins back to[n]the Velvet Room as ordered...
